# AccessibleMadeFlexible

**Enterprise-grade accessibility remediation OS.**

## What It Is
A production-ready SaaS platform for continuous accessibility issue discovery, scanning, clustering, and source-level remediation. Built on the AROS engine.

## What It's NOT
- An accessibility overlay
- A "one-click" compliance tool  
- A score-only dashboard

## Core Features
- Multi-scanner pipeline (axe-core, lighthouse, htmlcs, wave)
- Issue clustering by component pattern
- AI-assisted remediation suggestions
- Source-level fix routing
- VPAT/ATAG evidence exports

## Quick Start
```bash
git clone https://github.com/Hardonian/FlexibleAccessible
cd FlexibleAccessible
docker compose up -d
npm run dev
```

## Architecture
- Next.js web app
- Worker for background jobs
- PostgreSQL + Prisma
- Redis for queues
